About

About Goldapples
Media Associates

Communication deserves more attention. So does what happens after it.

A message can create clarity or confusion. A conversation can build trust or deepen division. A strategy can inspire action or disappear in translation.

Goldapples Media Associates is a Lagos-based communication advisory, executive education and development communication firm. We help people and institutions understand communication better and put that understanding to work.

Our Evolution

OOur roots are in communication services, born out of our experience in broadcasting, journalism, media and storytelling. Over time, our work has grown to include leadership communication, institutional advisory, executive learning and development communication.

One question connects it all: What happens after the message is delivered?

Our Philosophy

Communication is the operating system of human relations.

Communication shapes how people relate, how organisations function and how societies respond to change. We believe it deserves the same seriousness given to strategy, systems and performance.

Consciousness:Understand how messages are created, interpreted and experienced.

Responsibility:Communicate with integrity, empathy and awareness of consequences.

Effectiveness:Improve understanding and enable purposeful decisions and action.

Mutual understanding does not mean mutual agreement. We can understand one another more accurately, even when our positions remain different.

What Makes Us Different

We diagnose before we prescribe.

We investigate meaning, context, trust and feedback before recommending interventions.

We connect communication to real outcomes.

The test is not simply whether a message was sent, but whether people understood what mattered and could respond appropriately.

We turn thinking into tools.

Original frameworks inform practical diagnostics, advisory, facilitation and learning.

Founder

J. Ayo Makinde

Founder and Lead Communication Strategist

For more than three decades, J. Ayo Makinde has worked with communication in its many forms: newsrooms, broadcasting, interviews, content leadership, executive learning and development initiatives.

Across those experiences, one lesson kept returning. What people say is important. What others understand, believe and do next is just as important.

Through Goldapples, he brings together media experience, strategic thinking and practical learning to help people and institutions communicate with greater consciousness, responsibility and effectiveness.

Our Aspiration

To advance the understanding of communication as central to human relationships, organisations and societies.

Goldapples Media Associates is a communication advisory, executive education, and development communication firm helping leaders and institutions strengthen understanding, trust, alignment, and action.
